description.value: Glenora Farm is a biodynamic, life-sharing community near Duncan on Vancouver Island where adults with developmental disabilities live and work alongside caregivers as part of the international Camphill movement. The farm produces organic vegetables, candles, and other workshop goods, some of which are sold at local markets. The website describes the property as people's private homes where visitor access requires advance approval.
